subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact Private Mode guarantee should OpenClaw enforce across context reads, transcript/session storage, memory/compaction, plugin artifacts, channel history, logs, and Control UI?
rationale: This request creates a user-visible privacy/security boundary across multiple owners, and current main has no single session mode or field that downstream paths can enforce safely.

options.title: Define full private-session contract
options.body: Add one additive private-session mode with explicit no-context/no-persist semantics that every storage, memory, plugin, channel, and UI path must honor.

options.title: Narrow to context-only demo mode
options.body: Ship a clearly named context-suppression mode only if maintainers do not want to promise no durable history or memory writes yet.

options.title: Defer with documented mitigations
options.body: Keep this open and document current partial controls such as contextInjection:"never" without claiming private sessions.

recommendation.title: Define full private-session contract
recommendation.body: Add one additive private-session mode with explicit no-context/no-persist semantics that every storage, memory, plugin, channel, and UI path must honor.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled the canonical review and framed the remaining product/security contract that blocks implementation.
